title: Kheli
shortDescription: Post what you need, get help from people nearby.
fullDescription:
Kheli — get everyday tasks done with help from people nearby.

Need a hand moving furniture, fixing something at home, walking a dog, or running an errand? Kheli connects you with people in your area who are ready to help. Post what you need, set your price, and let nearby helpers come to you.

How it works

Post a request — describe the task, choose a category, add a price, and attach photos so helpers know exactly what you need.
Pin it on the map — drop your request at the right spot so people nearby can find it.
Connect — browse requests around you and reach out to get things done.
Why you'll love Kheli

• Local and map-based — see requests near you on an interactive map and find help close by.
• Post in seconds — add a title, category, price, and photos with a few taps.
• Browse freely — explore what people in your community need help with.
• Photo support — attach images to any request so there's no confusion.
• Phone-verified accounts — every user signs up with a verified phone number for added trust.
• Simple and clean — no clutter, just a fast way to ask for or offer help.
• Free to use — get started at no cost.

Perfect for

• Home tasks, repairs, and odd jobs
• Moving and heavy lifting
• Errands and deliveries
• Pet care and dog walking
• Cleaning and yard work
• Anything you'd ask a neighbor for a hand with

Whether you need help today or want to lend a hand to someone nearby, Kheli makes it easy to connect with your community and get things done.
Download Kheli and post your first request today.
